marketing_description: The Oliver Machinery Helical Cutterhead Planer model 4430.201 delivers a 20‑inch cutting width and 6‑inch cutting thickness with selectable depth of cut at 1/8‑inch or 3/16‑inch. Powered by a 5 hp motor at 230 V, 15 A, 60 Hz, it runs at 3450 RPM and offers two speeds with feed rates of 16 or 20 fpm. The unit features a digital control with magnetic switch, handwheel handle, and an iron housing on a 21‑inch by 20‑inch table.
